verdict.rationale: The docs set a per-meeting scale limit of 25 simultaneous videos, one video source per attendee. They also describe one adaptation behavior: bandwidth-constrained clients fall back to a lower-bitrate stream. However, the evidence never states a total attendee or viewer limit per session, nor what changes as a meeting grows past thresholds. Missing for 10: documented maximum attendee/viewer count per session, explicit description of behavior changes as session size grows (e.g., beyond video cap, large-audience/broadcast modes), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor documents how many participants or viewers one session supports and what changes as a session grows

citations.quote: Each attendee can publish one video source, up to a total of 25 simultaneous videos per meeting.
Clients with bandwidth constraints automatically subscribe to the lower bitrate stream.
